fact_check.fact: Donanemab slowed cognitive decline on the iADRS with p=0.042
fact_check.note: Checked against source document primary endpoint results (Mean Difference 3.20, 95% CI 0.12 to 6.27, p=0.042).

fact_check.fact: Donanemab failed to show statistically significant superiority on the CDR-SB
fact_check.note: Checked against source document secondary endpoint results (Mean Difference -0.36, 95% CI -0.83 to 0.12, p=0.139).

fact_check.fact: Donanemab reduced brain amyloid plaque deposition by 85 Centiloids
fact_check.note: Checked against source document secondary endpoint results (Mean Difference -85.06, p<0.001).
This headline figure popularized in mainstream media stems from the subsequent Phase 3 TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2 trial, not the Phase 2 TRAILBLAZER-ALZ results reported in this document.

research_page.title: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ Phase 2: Donanemab in early AD
research_page.description: Phase 2 trial showing donanemab effectively clears amyloid plaques and provides borderline significant slowing of decline on the iADRS, while missing standard secondary endpoints.
research_page.takeaway_md: Donanemab achieved dramatic amyloid plaque clearance over 76 weeks and met its primary endpoint for slowing decline on the iADRS (p=0.042). However, standard cognitive endpoints like the CDR-SB and MMSE did not reach statistical significance in this Phase 2 trial. These marginal clinical benefits despite massive biomarker changes prompted early skepticism that was later resolved by Phase 3 data.
key_findings_md: Met the primary endpoint on the iADRS, slowing decline versus placebo (mean difference 3.20, p=0.042) (source document).
Dramatically reduced brain amyloid plaque deposition compared to placebo (mean difference -85.06 Centiloids, p<0.001) (source document).
Failed to show statistically significant superiority on the CDR-SB (p=0.139), MMSE (p=0.227), or ADCS-iADL (p=0.230) (source document).
research_page.methods_md: Phase 2 double-blind, placebo-controlled trial randomizing 272 adults aged 60-85 with early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease and positive amyloid and tau PET scans. Evaluated donanemab IV every 4 weeks over 76 weeks.
research_page.trial_evidence_md: This trial ([TRAILBLAZER-ALZ](/trials/trailblazer-alz-nct03367403)) provided the first efficacy signal for donanemab. The discrepancy between the borderline primary iADRS and non-significant secondary CDR-SB outcomes initially fueled debate over clinical meaningfulness. These findings were subsequently validated by the much larger [TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2](/trials/trailblazer-alz-2) Phase 3 trial, which met all primary and secondary endpoints and led to full FDA approval in 2024.
research_page.sentiment_md: Public perception is highly polarized. Mainstream media and general audiences frequently focus on breakthrough top-line efficacy figures, while patients and caregivers weigh modest benefits against the logistical burden of treatment. Conversely, scientific communities and investigative journalists remain skeptical of the marginal Phase 2 clinical benefits relative to safety risks like brain bleeds (ARIA).
caveats_md: The combination therapy arm (donanemab + LY3202626) was discontinued mid-trial for futility, causing an unbalanced trial structure.
Phase 2 clinical benefits were inconsistent across rating scales, relying on the composite iADRS to achieve statistical significance while failing on standard independent measures.
relates_to_md: [TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 3](/trials/trailblazer-alz-3) — Ongoing Phase 3 prevention trial in preclinical Alzheimer's disease.
[Amyloid hypothesis](/research/amyloid-hypothesis) — Trial results highlight the complex relationship between dramatic biomarker clearance and modest short-term cognitive outcomes.

trial_pages.title: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ (Phase 2)
trial_pages.description: Phase 2 trial of donanemab in adults with early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
trial_pages.population: Adults aged 60-85 with early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease
trial_pages.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in the iADRS Score at 76 weeks
trial_pages.why_md: Designed to evaluate whether donanemab's rapid clearance of amyloid plaques could slow cognitive and functional decline in early Alzheimer's disease.
trial_pages.results_md: Demonstrated highly significant amyloid plaque reduction and met its primary iADRS endpoint (p=0.042). Failed to achieve statistical significance on standard secondary cognitive endpoints including the CDR-SB and MMSE.

trial_pages.title: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2
trial_pages.description: Pivotal Phase 3 trial of donanemab in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
trial_pages.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline on the iADRS
trial_pages.why_md: The confirmatory pivotal trial necessary to validate the borderline clinical efficacy seen in the Phase 2 TRAILBLAZER-ALZ study and support FDA approval.
status_log_md: **2023-04** — Readout confirming clinical efficacy, followed by full publication in JAMA in July 2023.
trial_pages.results_md: Successfully confirmed Phase 2 findings, significantly slowing clinical decline on both the iADRS and CDR-SB compared to placebo over 76 weeks.

timeline_entries.title: 2021-03 — Donanemab Phase 2 (TRAILBLAZER-ALZ) readout
timeline_entries.body_md: Eli Lilly reports Phase 2 results for donanemab showing robust amyloid clearance and a borderline significant slowing of decline on the primary iADRS endpoint, [though missing secondary clinical measures](/research/papers/trailblazer-alz-phase-2).
